title: Crytaltechno Optimized
description: Crystaltechno Optimized is a project focused on maximizing Minecraft’s performance while enhancing gameplay with quality-of-life improvements.
body:
Crystaltechno Optimized

Crystaltechno Optimized** is a Minecraft modpack focused on maximizing performance while improving the PvP experience with useful quality-of-life features.

The pack is designed to increase FPS, reduce lag, and provide smoother gameplay while keeping the core Minecraft experience close to vanilla. It includes lightweight optimization mods and helpful PvP utilities.

Features

- ⚡ FPS and performance optimizations
- 🛡️ PvP-focused quality-of-life improvements
- 🎯 Dynamic Crosshair for better aiming feedback
- 🍎 AppleSkin to display hunger and saturation
- 💻 Lightweight and optimized for many systems

## Why use this modpack?

Crystaltechno Optimized is ideal for players who want better performance and useful PvP features without heavily changing vanilla Minecraft.  
It keeps the game fast, clean, and competitive.helpful PvP features without heavily modifying the original Minecraft gameplay.
